name: Halay AI Trend: Dance the TV Show Halay With Two Friends
blurb: The halay AI trend puts you and your friends into a classic Turkish TV moment, a halay dance on a music show stage.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same TV studio stage with a glossy white floor, cream tufted leather sofas, a low gold coffee table, a warm wall of marquee lights, glowing star and music-note signs, a microphone stand and the big white drum in front, the same drummer who beats the drum, the same wide shot and then the same low camera on the floor beside the drum, the same cut, framing, timing and dance moves. Three changes only: the three men who dance the halay line arm in arm are now the three people in [Image 1], [Image 2] and [Image 3], always in this order from left to right, in every shot.

The leader on the left, who waves the white handkerchief over the head and down to the floor, sinks into deep, wobbly knee bends, kicks one foot high and laughs = the person in [Image 1], never the dark-haired man in the teal palm-print shirt of the original video: his face, his stubble and his teal shirt never come back, also while the leader laughs with the mouth wide open.
The one in the middle, who holds the leader up by the arm = the person in [Image 2].
The one on the right, who keeps the steps with a calm face = the person in [Image 3].

Each one, in every frame, in the wide shot and in every low shot: copy the exact face from their own image - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or headscarf exactly as in the photo - with the body and the clothes from their own image, so their friends instantly recognize all three, also in the low shots beside the drum. If a photo shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancers' faces, never mix the three faces, never add or remove facial hair. No teal palm-print shirt, no white tank top and no beige t-shirt unless an image shows one.

Anatomy rules: one head per dancer, on their own shoulders. Two arms and two legs each, no extra limbs. The drummer keeps his own face and never gets a face from the images. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no watermark, no extra people on the stage.
